title: The "patient journey" that isn't a journey at all.
excerpt: A journey implies direction. Someone walking alongside you. But what most patients get is a maze with no map!

title: A patient can be standing in the right place and still feel completely lost
excerpt: The most damaging patient experience failures don't announce themselves. They arrive in the form of a hesitation, a glance, a moment of uncertainty, and they never show up in your operational reports.

title: Why Patients Drop Off Before Consultation
excerpt: Not every lost patient looks like a no-show. Some arrive and never check in. Some check in — and still leave before seeing a doctor. These are not different problems. They are the same signal.

title: Healthcare digital systems fail the patient experience. Here's how it's fixed.
excerpt: Hospitals are more digitized than ever. Yet patients still feel confused, lost, and unsupported. The problem isn't the technology, it's the 'missing layer' between it.

title: How firstpass enables person-centered care.

title: How to get more out of your Conversational AI.
